concept: Website and CRM built as one, as a duplicate book, rendered in 3D (Blender). One made-up enquiry written once on the white top sheet (Website enquiry, No 0218) and come through in carbon on the yellow sheet under it (CRM copy, No 0218). The foot of the top sheet rolled back: they filled in your form, who types it up? The top sheet flipped over the binding and the whole copy in view: nobody, it's already in your CRM. Then the top sheet torn out and laid across the copy, the same red number on both: website and CRM, built as one. Cobalt table, white paper, canary-yellow copy, biro blue and one red number.
